content.short: We are building a metaverse to bring communities closer.
content.description:
In this project we are building a whole universe owned and managed by the users. This virtual world will reinforce cryptocurrency and nft communities by giving them the opportunity to meet and interact together. It will allow creators to build a whole set of new utilities on top of the many existing tokens & coins in the crypto space.

One of our objectives is to set a minimum amount of restrictions on the size of the universe. We want the user to be able to build a whole planet and live thousands of light-years away if that's what they want to do. We want everyone to have a place in our metaverse.

That is why there will be a seemingly unlimited amount of space chunks and the mint price will be kept low. Chunks near the center will become extremely valuable with time since new chunks will always be minted further away from the center.
